# Quotation response -- SOLMU-RFQ-2026-14

## Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is a technical property maintenance contractor based in Jyvaskyla, covering LVI, electrical, building automation and property services.

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy meets the insurance and electrical contracting requirements for this quotation. Relevant reference project: a comparable private-sector contract worth approximately EUR 820,000. Visakoivu also meets the revenue threshold.

### Technical response

**Condition monitoring.** Data is logged at scheduled maintenance visits and reviewed for trends.

**Continuity.** Team-based staffing with documented handover on personnel changes, so service continues uninterrupted.

**Waste handling.** Waste is sorted on site per the applicable plan.

**Warranty.** Standard warranty terms apply to installed equipment.

**Electrical inspections.** Carried out per the statutory schedule.

**Worker qualifications.** Field staff hold the required qualifications for site work.

**Service visits.** Content and scheduling are agreed with centre management in advance of each visit.

**Emergency response.** Section 4.10 states a 4-hour response time from notification.

### Commercial terms

Billing follows the frequency and format required. Pricing follows a unit-price structure.

### Quotation format

Price stated as EUR/m2/year. This response is within the stated page limit.

### Annex note

The annex's technical cross-reference states a 2-hour response-time figure alongside the 4-hour figure in Section 4.10; both are noted here for the buyer's attention.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to submit this quotation.
